title: Misstated Statement Amounts on Service-Recovery Courtesies, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Clause.** On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account owed a service-recovery courtesy, every summary statement issued on the account counts as a statement sent at the misstated figure, and the starting amount already answers for the first: three or more add 15.00 USD, exactly two add 10.00, and a single statement adds nothing.

| Summary statements issued on the account | Amount added |
|---|---|
| three or more | 15.00 |
| exactly two | 10.00 |
| one | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- Only summary statements count; an itemized statement or a final notice is not a summary statement.
- *Case (hypothetical).* An account with four summary statements and one itemized statement adds 15.00, the same as three.
